## Menu & Services

- [Gourmet Pizzas](https://raggiogourmetpizza.com/#menu): Fresh artisanal pizzas made with Grande Mozzarella and signature sauces.
- [Calzones & Strombolis](https://raggiogourmetpizza.com/#menu): Traditional handcrafted folded Italian pies.
- [Salads & Appetizers](https://raggiogourmetpizza.com/#menu): Fresh garden salads, wings, and side starters.
- [Catering Services](https://raggiogourmetpizza.com/#catering): Event catering and group dining solutions in Delaware.
